ReturningToPrayer.6: Matanho akajairika okudzokera kumunyengetero pashure pokuenda kumwedzi, norugare rwomupfungwa.
ReturningToPrayer.8: AWA haibudisi fatwa kana kutonga kwechitendero kwakagadzirirwa.
ReturningToPrayer.12: Kudzokorora munyengetero, pasina kugadzira minyengetero yakarasika
ReturningToPrayer.14: Ghusl inzira huru yekugeza: inoumbwa nekugeza muviri wose nechinangwa chekudzokera kumamiriro ekuchena kwetsika (tahara), inodiwa pakuita munamato uye zvimwe zviito zvekunamata.
ReturningToPrayer.15: Usati waita ghusl, zvakakosha kuti uve nechokwadi chokuti nguva yekare yapera: ghusl inofanira kutevera, kwete kutangira, chokwadi chekuti kubuda ropa kwakamira. Kazhinji kutaura, izvi zvinogamuchirwa nekumira zvachose kwekubuda ropa, kunoonekwa kwenguva yakakwana yekubvisa kusahadzika  ⁇  pfungwa yakadzokororwa zvakadzama muchinyorwa chakatsaurirwa kuchena kwerutambo.
ReturningToPrayer.16: Kucheneswa uku ndiko kunoita kuti ukwanise kubatanidzwazve nenguva dzokunamata dzakatemwa panguva yokushaya ropa.
ReturningToPrayer.18: Hapana chikonzero chokumhanyira: ghusl inogona kuitwa kana wagadzirira, pasina kumanikidzwa, kana nguva yokunaya kwemwedzi yapera.
ReturningToPrayer.19: Ghusl inobva pamitemo yakajairika: chinangwa chekuzvichenesa, uye kugeza kwakakwana kwemuviri, kusanganisira bvudzi uye ganda.
ReturningToPrayer.21: Hapana nzira chaiyo inoratidzwa pano seyoyo yoga inoshanda: kutaura nezvezvikoro kana kuti maonero aunowanzotevera, kana kuti kutsvaka zano kubva kune nyanzvi yakakodzera, kuchakubatsira kudzidza mashoko chaiwo akakodzera mamiriro ako ezvinhu.
ReturningToPrayer.22: Kana nguva dzomwedzi dzapera uye mhemberero yacho yapera, munyengetero unotangazve kuita, pasina kunonoka kana kuti zvimwe zvinhu.
ReturningToPrayer.23: ⁇ Zvinobatsira kusiyanisa pakati pemamiriro ezvinhu maviri anotevera mitemo yakasiyana: minamato isingaitwi panguva yemwedzi kazhinji haibatsirwe, nepo mazuva ekuzvinyima zvokudya akarasika panguva yeRamadan anofanirwa kuitwa gare gare (qadaa).

SideEffects.6: Zvimwe zvinogona kuitika nguva pfupi, asi zvimwe zvinoda kuti tizviongorore. Dzidza kusiyanisa zvinoitika uye zviratidzo zvinofanira kuongororwa.

SideEffects.65: Nyaya ino inoitirwa kuti vanhu vazive uye haitsivi mazano emurapi anopiwa munhu oga.

week1.0: Pamuviri panotangira zuva rokutanga remwedzi wako wokupedzisira, maererano nemutemo wezvokurapa.
week1.1: Nguva iyi inowanzouya vasati vabayiwa pamuviri; kazhinji hakuna kuchinja kwemuviri kunoitika panguva yeimba.
week1.2: Kuverenga pamuviri kubva panguva yapfuura kunopa nzira yakajairika yokufungidzira zuva rokuberekwa, kunyange zvazvo pamuviri chaizvoizvo kuchizova nenguva yakati gare gare.
week1.3: Zvakajairika kuti hapana kuchinja kunooneka panguva ino.

week2.0: Kubuda kwezvibereko uye kufukidza kunogona kuitika kazhinji kazhinji kunoitika panguva ino, zvichienderana nehuwandu hwenguva yemunhu mumwe nomumwe.
week2.1: Nguva yekubuda ovulation inogona kusiyana zvichienderana nehuremu hwekupinda, izvo zvinokanganisa zuva chairo rinogona kuitika rokuberekwa.
week2.2: Kazhinji kazhinji hapana kuchinja kwomuviri kunokosha pamuviri panguva ino.
week2.3: Nguva chaiyo yokusununguka kwemapfupa inosiyana-siyana, ndokusaka nguva iyi ichiri fungidziro.

week3.0: Kana kufukidza kwaitika, zai rinotanga kupatsanurwa uye kufamba richienda muchibereko, asi hapana chinogona kuonekwa nechero kuongorora kwomwana.
week3.1: Vhiki rino richiri mukati menguva yokurapa yokutanga-tanga kutenderera pamuviri; hapana chiratidzo chomuviri chinowanzooneka panguva ino.
week3.2: Kuongororwa kwakawanda kwomuviri wemvura kunovimbika kubva vhiki rinotevera, kana kuiswa muviri.

week4.0: Muviri wacho uchangobva kuiswa mumadziro omudumbu, uye muhomwe yemukadzi uye muhomwe yemaruva, iyo ichamupa zvokudya mumazuva okutanga, iri kuumbwa.
week4.3: Vamwe vanhu havaoni chiratidzo chero chipi zvacho panguva ino yokutanga.
week4.4: Kuongororwa kwepamuviri mumvura kazhinji kacho kunogona kuona kuti munhu ane pamuviri kubva vhiki rino zvichienda mberi.
week4.5: Ino ndiyo nguva inowanzoitika apo bvunzo dzokubereka pamuviri dzinogona kutanga kupa mugumisiro wakanaka.

week5.0: Sisitimu yetsinga inotanga kuumbwa, uye mwoyo, uchiri muduku, wava kuda kurova kekutanga.
week5.3: Kuneta kusingawanzoitiki, kusuruvara kwakareruka, kana kuti kuoma kwechifuva kunogona kuoneka.
week5.4: Ino ndiyo nguva inokurudzirwa yokuronga kusangana nenyanzvi yezvokurapa kuti utange kurapwa pamuviri.

week6.0: Mavara emarumbo nemakumbo anooneka, pamwe chete nemaburi maduku anoumba nzeve.
week6.3: Vamwe vanhu vanogona kunzwa kusuruvara uye kuneta zvakanyanya panguva iyi.
week6.4: Dzimwe nguva basa remwoyo rinogona kuoneka vhiki rino pa ultrasound yokutanga.

week7.0: Uropi hunokura nokukurumidza kupfuura zvimwe zvinhu zvose zvomuviri, zvichiita kuti rutivi rwomusoro ruve rwakakurumbira.
week7.3: Zvido zvokudya zvakati, kana kuti zvinopesana, kusada zvokudya zvimwe, zvinogoneka.
week7.4: Muviri wemutsipa, unobereka uropi nomupfupa, unoramba uchivhara mumavhiki aya.

week8.0: Mwana wacho zvino anonzi mwana ari kufutiswa, maoko ake ari kuwedzera kureba, musoro unotanga kutwasuka zvishoma, uye mwana ari mumimba anoramba achiumbwa.
week8.3: Kuziva kunhuwidza uye kushaya simba mangwanani zvinowanzoitika panguva ino, kunyange zvazvo zvisiri zvose.
week8.4: Ultrasound yokutanga yokufambidzana inowanzogadzirirwa pakati pevhiki ye8 ne14 yevhiki.

week9.0: Zvinhu zvomumeso zvinova zvakajeka, maziso anodzivirira maziso, uye maoko netsoka zviri kuumbwa neminwe neminwe yemberi.
week9.3: Kuneta kunoratidza uye kusuruvara kungaramba kuripo; kazhinji kazhinji kunopera pakupera kwedomu rokutanga.
week9.4: Nhengo dzokuzvibata nadzo dziri kungotanga kusiyanisa, asi murume nomukadzi kazhinji haasi kuzivikanwa kusvikira papera nguva refu, pachiratidzo chechiratidzo.

week10.0: Chiso chinova chinozivikanwa, maziso anoona chiedza, uye mwoyo unorova nokukurumidza, kanenge katatu kupfuura kwevanhu vakuru.
week10.3: Mujaho wako unogona kutanga kuchinja zvishoma, kunyange zvazvo dumbu risati raonekwa.
week10.4: Kuongororwa kwakabatana kwepakutanga kwemwedzi, kana kuchipiwa, kunowanzoitwa pakati pevhiki 11 ne14 yevhiki.

week11.0: Minwe neminwe zvakapatsanurwa, zvipikiri zviduku zvinobuda, uye placenta zvishoma nezvishoma inotora nzvimbo kubva muhomwe yemaruva mukudyisa mwana mudumbu.
week11.3: Unogona kuona kuchinja kwemanzwiro, kunobatanidzwa zvikurukuru nokuchinja kwehomoni.
week11.4: Kufamba kwomwana kuri kutanga, asi kazhinji hausi kuoneka panguva ino.

week12.0: Zvirongwa zvemukati nemhasuru zvakakura zvakanaka, uye skeleton iri kutanga kusvibiswa. Zvirongwa zvekuzvara zvakaumbwa, kunyange zvazvo zvisati zvaonekwa pa ultrasound.
week12.3: Kufinhwa kunowanzova nyore nyore panguva ino, kunyange zvazvo izvi zvichienderana zvikuru nomunhu nomumwe.
week12.4: Kupera kwemwedzi wokutanga wokubereka kazhinji kunobatanidzwa nenjodzi yakaderera yokusununguka kana ichienzaniswa nevhiki dzakapfuura.

week13.0: Vamwe vana vanotova nemafungiro ekuti vanonyura muchanza.
week13.3: Vanhu vakawanda vanodzoka zvishoma nezvishoma nesimba sezvo mwedzi wechipiri wava pedyo.
week13.4: Kutarisa kwokutanga kunowanzopera vhiki rino; kutarisirwa kunoenderera mberi nokuiswa nguva dzakawanda.

week14.0: Musoro unova wakakomberedzwa uye unofambidzana nemuviri wose.
week14.3: Vamwe vanhu vanotanga kuona dumbu richizvambarara.
week14.4: Mumwe munhu anoona nezveutano anogona kutanga kunzwa kurova kwemoyo wake achishandisa ultrasound.

week15.0: Panenge pachine zvishoma nezvishoma panenge paine denga rinonzi lanugo rinofukidza ganda, uye maziso anotanga kuoneka uye maziso anova anonzwa chiedza.
week15.3: Chido chako chokudya chinogona kuchinja, dzimwe nguva nemhaka yokushaya zvokudya kana kuti kuvenga.
week15.4: Kunzwa kunotanga kukura panguva ino: inzwi rako nemapapuranga omuviri wako zvinotanga kuoneka zvishoma nezvishoma.

week16.0: Masimba etsinga anoita kuti maoko nemakumbo zvifambe zvakanaka uye maoko anogona kusangana nemakumbo.
week16.3: Vamwe vanhu vanotanga kunzwa kufamba kwakareruka zvikuru kubva panguva ino, kazhinji kunotsanangurwa sokupururudza.
week16.4: Kunzwa kufamba kwekutanga kunosiyana zvikuru kubva pamuviri mumwe kusvika kune mumwe, kunyanya zvichienderana nokuti pamuviri wokutanga here kana kuti kwete.

week17.0: Maziso, achiri akavharwa, anogona kufamba, uye mwana zvino anoteerera manzwi makuru.
week17.3: Kurwadziwa kuri mumusana kunogona kuoneka sezvo nzvimbo yako yokurema ichishanduka.
week17.4: Manzwi okunze ari kutanga kuonekwa, ari mumhando yakadzimwa, kupfurikidza nemvura yemumuno.

week18.0: Kunzwa, kubata, kumedza, uye kutakura kunoita mwana zvinoramba zvichiwedzera.
week18.3: Panenge panguva iyi panenge paine dumbu rinooneka, uye nzvimbo yako yokurema inoramba ichishanduka.
week18.4: Chirongwa cheanatomy ultrasound, chinoongorora kukura kwomwana, chinowanzoitwa pakati pevhiki 18 nevhiki 21.

week19.0: Mazino anogara aripo anotanga kuumbwa pashure pokugadzirira mazino emwana, uye mwana wacho anoramba achiwedzera uremu zvishoma nezvishoma.
week19.3: Kunzwa kwekukweva kumativi omudumbu (kurwadziwa kwematanda akatenderera) kunogona kuitika apo chibereko chinokura.
week19.4: Ino inguva yakajairika yokutanga kunzwa kufamba kwomwana  ⁇  zvakajeka.

week20.0: Kubva vhiki rino zvichienda mberi, kureba kunoyera kubva kumusoro kusvika kumusoro panzvimbo pemusoro kusvika pasi, sezvo makumbo zvino achigona kuwedzerwa nekuyerwa  ⁇  izvi zvinotsanangura kusvetuka kunooneka muhukuru hwechirevo zvichienzaniswa nemasvondo apfuura.
week20.3: Chiropa chako chakakomberedzwa zvakanaka chinogona kutanga kukanganisa kuenzana kwako uye chimiro chako.
week20.4: Pakati pokubata pamuviri pane nguva dzakawanda apo unonyatsoongororwa nevashandi vezveutano.

week21.0: Kufamba kunova kwakajeka uye kunobatanidzwa, uye zvinowanzoitika kuti utange kuvanzwa zvakajeka munguva ino.
week21.3: Kufema kwakapfava kunogona kuoneka kana munhu achishanda nesimba sezvo chibereko chichitora nzvimbo yakawanda.
week21.4: Kuziva mafambiro anoita mwana wako kunoita kuti zvive nyore kuona kuchinja kusingawanzoitiki.

week22.0: Mapapu anoramba achivandudza, uye mwana ari kuita mafambiro maduku okufema.
week22.3: Vamwe vanhu vanogona kuva nemakumbo, kunyanya usiku.
week22.4: Zvaunodya zvinogona kukanganisa mvura yemumimba yemwana, iyo mwana anogara achidya.

week23.0: Mwana wacho ari kudzidzira kufema uye ari kutanga kuchinja nguva dzokurara nokumuka.
week23.3: Kurwadziwa kwakanyanya kumashure kunogona kuoneka nokuwedzera uremu zvishoma nezvishoma.
week23.4: Kuona nguva dzomwana dzinoshanda uye dzakanyanya kunobatsira kuti udzidze kurira kwaanoita.

week24.0: Mwana anosvika pamuganhu wokurarama: kana akaberekwa nguva isati yakwana panguva ino, kurapwa kwevana kunokwanisa kuita kuti apone, achitsigirwa zvakakodzera.
week24.3: Kuwedzera kwesimba pamapapu uye kuda kukurumidza kukambaira kunogona kuoneka.
week24.4: Kuongororwa kwechirwere cheshuga chepamuviri kunowanzorongwa panguva ino.

week25.0: Mwana zvino anoteerera ruzha rukuru nokutsamwa kana kuti kurova, uye dzimwe nguva anogona kunzwa kushaya simba.
week25.3: Kupisa kwechido kana kuti acid reflux zvinogona kuwedzera.
week25.4: Kuzvimba kwomwana kunoonekwa nguva nenguva kunowanzonzi kwakanaka.

week26.0: Maziso anozaruka kekutanga. Ruvara rwawo rwokupedzisira kazhinji haruzombozivikanwi kusvikira mwedzi yakati kuti pashure pokuberekwa.
week26.3: Kuzvimba kushoma kwematsoka kana kuti tsoka kunogona kuoneka, kunyanya pakupera kwezuva.
week26.4: Nguva yechitatu yechirwere ichi yava pedyo, uye kazhinji kazhinji chiremba anowedzera kuongorora.

week27.0: Mapapu anokwanisa kutanga kufema, uye mwana anoramba achizadza sechibayiro chefuta pasi peganda.
week27.3: Kuneta kunogona kudzoka sezvo muviri wako uchirema.
week27.4: Kutanga kwemwedzi wechitatu kazhinji inguva yakanaka yokutanga kufunga nezverongwa rwekuberekwa kwako.

week28.0: Kurova kwemoyo, kunokurumidza zvikuru mukutanga kwomuviri, kwakadzikama pamwero unenge 130 kusvika ku140 paminiti uye zvino kunogona kunzwika ne stethoscope.
week28.3: Kufema kwakapera kana kuti kupisa kwechido chokurwadziwa kunogona kuwedzera sezvo chibereko chichitora nzvimbo yakawanda.
week28.4: Nguva yechitatu yechikadzi inowanzotanga vhiki ino, uye nguva dzokuonana dzinowedzera.

week29.0: Mwana wacho atovaka muviri; vhiki dziri kuuya dzinenge dzichiita kuti nhengo dzemuviri dzikure uye kuti uwedzere kuwanda.
week29.3: Kurara kungava kwakaoma kuwana nemhaka yokukura kwomudumbu wako.
week29.4: Kuzorora kurutivi rweruboshwe kunowanzorumbidzwa pakupedzisira pamuviri kuti utange kutenderera.

week30.0: Kuona kunoramba kuchikura; pakuzvarwa, mwana achakwanisa kuona zviso zviri pedyo, asati adzidza zvishoma nezvishoma kuteedzera zvinhu zviri kufamba.
week30.3: Kunzwa kurema mumusana kana kuti muperekedzi kunogona kuwedzera.
week30.4: Kusarudzwa kwemwana asati aberekwa kunowanzosvika pakuwanda kubva panguva ino zvichienda mberi.

week31.0: Mwana wacho anofamba-famba, dzimwe nguva anotsvoda minwe yake, uye anogona kufamba-famba zvikuru.
week31.3: Kuita kuti munhu atange kuora mwoyo, kunonzi Braxton Hicks, kunogona kutanga kunzwika dzimwe nguva.
week31.4: Mwana ari kutanga kuziva dzimwe inzwi dzinozivikanwa dzinogara dzichinzwika kubva kunze.

week32.0: Mwana wacho atova akura uye ari kuenderera mberi nekugadzirira kuberekwa kwake.
week32.3: Kuwedzera kwakanyanya kuoneka kwehuremu kunowanzoitika munguva ino, kunobatanidzwa nekukura kwomwana.
week32.4: Kuiswa kwemusoro kumusoro (kuiswa kwemusoro) kunowedzera kuwanda sezvinenge zvichiitika.

week33.0: Uropi uye tsinga zvanyatsovandudzwa, uye mapfupa anoramba achioma, kunze kweaya ari muganda, ayo anoramba akasununguka kuti zvive nyore kupfuura nawo panguva yokuberekwa.
week33.3: Kuomerwa kuwana nzvimbo yokurara yakachengeteka kwakajairika panguva ino.
week33.4: Kuchinja kwemapfupa emusoro womunhu paanenge achiri mudumbu kunongova kwenguva pfupi uye kunopera zvishoma nezvishoma mugore rokutanga.
